case_number: 2025 INSC 37; MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATION NO. 2667 OF 2024 IN SLP(CRL.) NO. 895 OF 2024
summary: Compounding of non-compoundable offense under s.326 IPC; parties' amicable settlement after SLP dismissal; compromise covering property disputes and RI sentencing; period undergone basis for reduction; inherent powers exercise; conviction confirmed with sentence modification.
final_judgment: Miscellaneous Application allowed; SLP dismissal order recalled; conviction confirmed; sentence reduced to period already undergone; appeal partly allowed.
